items.title: Homebuilding stocks are feeling the bite of higher mortgage rates
items.summary: A rapid run-up in mortgage rates to around 7.5% and slumping revenues at Lennar and KB Home have pushed the S&P 500 Homebuilding Index down 3.2% this month.

items.title: Should You Buy Lowe's Stock For Its Cash?
items.summary: Lowe's Companies (LOW) generates free cash flow equal to 6.6% of its market value, against 4.5% for the median S&P 500 company. Counting its debt as part of the price, the yield is 5.0%. A yield that high usually means either a business on sale or one the market expects to shrink. Will its $7 billion of yearly cash keep coming, and its debt stay covered, while do-it-yourself shoppers hold back.

items.title: Lowe’s test drives drone delivery
items.summary: Lowe’s is testing drones to speed up its game in same-day delivery. The post Lowe’s test drives drone delivery appeared first on FreightWaves.

items.title: Lowe's Companies (LOW) Starts 20 Minute Drone Delivery Pilot
items.summary: Lowe's Companies (NYSE:LOW) has begun a drone delivery pilot for home improvement products with Wing and DoorDash in Matthews, N.C. The trial offers select DIY and Pro items delivered to customers from the Matthews store in as little as 20 minutes. Wing manages the drone operations, while DoorDash integrates the new option into its app for same day fulfillment of eligible orders. The new Lowe's drone delivery pilot with Wing and DoorDash is part of broader changes in its digital logistics...

items.title: Is Home Depot’s Dividend Safe if Housing Stays Frozen?
items.summary: Home Depot's stock sits near a 52-week low and housing turnover has been frozen for four years, yet the company keeps writing dividend checks. Whether that streak survives depends on three numbers investors should watch closely.

items.title: Lowe's (LOW) Stock Looks Reasonable On a 25% One Year Slide
items.summary: Lowe's Companies has seen its share price fall sharply over the past year, so the market has already marked the stock down. That raises a straightforward question for investors who care about fundamentals: do the cash flows that Lowe's can generate justify where the stock trades today? The share price has declined 24.9% over the past year, which puts the focus squarely on whether the current valuation is supported by Lowe's future cash generation. items.title: Is Home Depot's Next Big Thing Already In Its Stores?
items.summary: Home Depot (HD) shares have lost 27% over the past year, including dividends, while the S&P 500 returned 17.1%. A $10,000 holding a year ago is worth about $7,310 today. Management says housing affordability still weighs on bigger home projects. One part of the company is growing anyway: SRS, a unit with its own branches that sells to professionals. Is SRS already paying off inside Home Depot's own stores.

items.title: Musk’s ‘Zuckerberg moment,’ mortgage rates, and Google’s space bet
items.summary: In this episode on Sozzi Unleashed, Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi breaks down what mortgage rate surges mean for home improvement stocks, why Elon Musk may be the next leader to have a 'Mark Zuckerberg moment,' and what Alphabet's (GOOGL, GOOG) venture into space could mean for the business.
